attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: No extraction theorem converts arbitrary H_N circuits into constructively label-free codebook sketches. The trivial transcript T_N=H_N is small whenever H_N is small but is not label-free and may encode SAT-label information semantically.
steps: Fix the surviving escape regime L_N=(log N)^d with d>1, M_N=N^q, and max{rho,q}<1+epsilon.
Substitute a hypothetical size n^c SAT circuit into all N^q query slots; since L_N^c=N^{o(1)}, obtain C(H_N)<=N^{max{rho,q}+o(1)}.
Define LFSketch_N by an explicit codebook of U_N length-L_N formulas, a label-free transcript T_N, and a decoder producing a sparse polynomial in hardwired SAT labels of codebook entries.
Build a nonuniform circuit for H_N by computing T_N, evaluating the decoder, looking up hardwired codebook labels, evaluating at most A_N monomials, and patching E_N exceptional source inputs.
Conclude that any LFSketch_N with S_T+S_D+tildeO(U_N+A_Nr_N)+E_NN<N^{1+epsilon} is a concrete upper-bound falsifier for the desired source lower bound.
Attempt to prove the converse: small arbitrary circuits for H_N should yield small label-free sketches, making LFSketch hardness a source lower-bound certificate.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: The cycle proves a valid falsifier and preserves the target bridge, but it does not prove C(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon}. A sketch lower bound would still need a nonrelativizing, advice-accounted extraction theorem or a direct general-circuit lower bound for H_N.

assumptions: Circuit model is nonuniform fan-in-two Boolean circuits with equality patches charged O(N) gates per exceptional source input.
Generator uniformity is only size-bounded nonuniform constructibility; no hidden advice bit may encode SAT labels or H_N values.
A constructively label-free codebook B_N is an explicitly enumerable list of U_N formulas of length L_N computed without SAT-label queries.
The sparse quotient decoder, from transcript T_N(x), produces at most A_N monomials over at most r_N named codebook coordinates and never uses the SAT value of a generated formula as a control bit.
The sketch may fail on E_N source inputs; those are patched by nonuniform equality tests and therefore cost O(E_N N).
definitions: source object: H_N^{xor}:{0,1}^N -> {0,1} is H_N(x)=\oplus_{j\le M_N} SAT(\Phi_{N,j}(x)), with M_N=N^q, query length L_N=(\log N)^d, d>1, and a label-free generator circuit for all \Phi_{N,j} of size N^rho.

target object: SAT on formulas of length L_N, measured by nonuniform Boolean circuits; the intended target consequence is SAT notin SIZE(n^c) for every fixed c, hence NP not subset P/poly only through this SAT complete problem.
controlled interface: substitute a size L_N^c SAT circuit into each generated query slot and combine by XOR, paying generator overhead N^rho and slot overhead N^q L_N^c polylog(N).

target-preserving condition: max{rho,q}<1+epsilon, L_N=(log N)^d is subpolynomial, the generator and transcript are independent of SAT labels, and the source lower bound holds on infinitely many valid N.

equations.label: xor_carrier_definition
equations.valid_when: Valid when the source object is the generated XOR-SAT carrier with fixed q,d and generator outputs well-formed SAT instances for every valid N.

equations.label: polylog_target_substitution
equations.valid_when: Applies after the controlled interface substitutes one nonuniform SAT circuit of length L_N into every generated query slot with L_N subpolynomial.

equations.label: magnification_window
equations.valid_when: Requires the target-preserving condition, cofinal valid source lengths, and a source lower bound exceeding the substitution upper bound for each fixed c.

equations.label: label_free_codebook_upper_bound
equations.valid_when: Valid when a constructively label-free transcript and decoder express H_N outside E_N bad inputs as a sparse polynomial in hardwired SAT labels of the enumerated codebook.

equations.label: source_falsifier_threshold
equations.valid_when: Valid in the nonuniform source model where codebook labels may be hardwired but the transcript construction itself contains no SAT-label advice.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If the transcript is allowed to depend on SAT labels, T_N=H_N becomes a one-bit sketch and the audit collapses; if U_N or E_NN is subthreshold, the source lower bound is refuted.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Quantitative route bridge plus concrete upper-bound falsifier for the XOR carrier; it narrows the source obligation without proving any lower bound.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For a polylog-query XOR-SAT carrier, any constructively label-free global-codebook sparse quotient sketch below N^{1+epsilon} gives an explicit nonuniform upper bound for H_N and is therefore a valid falsifier for the proposed barely-superlinear source lower bound. The target bridge remains C(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon} i.o. plus max{rho,q}<1+epsilon implies SAT notin P/poly, but sketch hardness is not itself a source lower bound.

assumptions: The extractor must be real-SAT-specific and nonrelativizing; relativizing separator or incidence arguments are insufficient.
The output transcript must be constructively label-free, not merely a restatement of the computed H_N value.
All advice introduced by extraction is charged to S_T,S_D,U_N,A_Nr_N, or E_NN.
definitions: source object: arbitrary nonuniform circuits computing the fixed XOR-SAT carrier H_N on N-bit source inputs.
target object: the label-free codebook sketch class LFSketch(U,A,r,E,S_T,S_D) from cycle61.L1.
controlled interface: transform a small H_N circuit into a label-free transcript, decoder, codebook, and sparse polynomial representation.
target-preserving condition: extraction loss kappa satisfies kappa<epsilon-sigma when starting from C(H_N)<=N^{1+sigma}.

equations.label: needed_extraction_threshold
equations.latex: C(H_N)\le N^{1+\sigma}\Rightarrow \exists\ LFSketch_N\text{ of cost }\le N^{1+\sigma+\kappa+o(1)}.
equations.valid_when: Valid only as a required bridge schema after the extraction algorithm is specified and all advice leakage is quantitatively charged.

equations.label: sketch_to_source_transfer
equations.valid_when: Applies only if the extraction implication is already proved for arbitrary small H_N circuits in the same nonuniform model.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A relativized oracle with easy H_N but no small label-free sketch, or the admissible label-dependent transcript T_N=H_N, falsifies any extraction-free promotion.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: No-go diagnostic for promoting structured sketch lower bounds to source lower bounds.
candidate_lemmas.statement: A lower bound against label-free codebook sketches can certify C(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon} only if every small arbitrary circuit for H_N admits a nonrelativizing extraction into such a label-free sketch with subthreshold loss. Without this extraction, sketch hardness is only absence of one falsifier class.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot if no candidate extraction theorem can avoid label-dependent transcripts or if every explicit generator yields subthreshold codebook entropy.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote only if a proof shows either direct C(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon} or an advice-accounted extraction from arbitrary H_N circuits to constructively label-free codebook sketches with loss kappa<epsilon-sigma.
control_decision.reason: The branch made route-level progress by refining a concrete falsifier class and preserving the polylog-query target bridge, but it cannot promote sketch hardness to P/poly separation yet.

dependency_updates.description: Constructively label-free global codebook sketches refine earlier sparse quotient-polynomial sketches by charging hardwired SAT labels and excluding T_N=H_N leakage.
Need a nonrelativizing extraction from arbitrary small H_N circuits to label-free sketches before sketch lower bounds can certify source lower bounds.
The old q+beta c transfer remains the no-go certificate for any attempted polynomial-query rollback; the current XOR route stays only because L_N is polylogarithmic.

falsifiers: label-dependent one-bit transcript falsifier: omitting label-freeness admits T_N(x)=H_N(x) and destroys the sketch audit.
small global codebook falsifier: U_N=N^{1+epsilon-omega(1)} with cheap decoder lets the circuit hardwire all relevant SAT labels.
patchable-error falsifier: E_N<N^{epsilon-o(1)} bad source inputs cost only E_NN<N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} gates.
positive-beta rollback falsifier: if L_N=N^beta with beta>0 then SAT in SIZE(n^c) gives C(H_N)<=N^{q+beta c+o(1)}, so only bounded c are excluded.
nonuniform leakage falsifier: generator or transcript advice that depends on SAT labels can compress the carrier while preserving apparent range entropy.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: If b+max{a,0}+error_exponent<1+epsilon, the hardwired-codebook circuit beats the claimed source lower bound; if b crosses 1+epsilon, the falsifier disappears but no lower bound follows.
held_fixed_controls: Nonuniform Boolean circuit size model for both H_N and SAT.
Subpolynomial query length L_N=(log N)^2, so target substitution has beta=0 in exponent accounting.
No SAT-label advice in the generator, transcript, or decoder.
Exact XOR aggregation over N^q slots, with equality patching charged O(N) per bad source input.
Target bridge threshold max{rho,q}<1+epsilon held fixed.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The branch has isolated a structured upper-bound class; varying codebook entropy gives a concrete phase boundary before attempting any abstract lower-bound claim.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: A high-q XOR-SAT carrier with q=1+epsilon-3eta, rho=1+epsilon-4eta, L_N=(log N)^2, and a label-free generator whose generated formulas are projected onto an explicitly enumerable quotient codebook B_N.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal certificate must list the codebook enumerator, transcript circuit, decoder cost, sparse support size, and error set size; only a separate nonrelativizing extraction theorem may transfer absence of such certificates into C(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon}.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: b=log_N U_N, the exponent of the constructively enumerable global codebook size; keep sparse decoder arity r_N=polylog(N) and monomial count A_N=N^a as secondary measured outputs.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 61 upgrades the XOR-carrier audit from vague label-free transcripts to a costed global-codebook normal form. The valid new contribution is an explicit upper-bound falsifier C(H_N)<=S_T+S_D+tildeO(U_N+A_Nr_N)+E_NN. This closes a leakage loophole in sparse quotient sketches, while exposing the exact remaining gap: absence of label-free sketches is not a general-circuit lower bound without a nonrelativizing extraction theorem.

negative_tactic_decision.conflict_target: Any claim that a positive-beta black-box carrier plus barely-superlinear H_N lower bound implies SAT notin P/poly for all polynomial exponents.
negative_tactic_decision.contradiction_carrier_or_no_go_family: If beta>0, SAT in SIZE(n^c) implies C(H_N)<=N^{max{rho,q+beta c}+o(1)}, contradicting any claimed all-exponent exclusion from an N^{1+epsilon} source lower bound once c>(1+epsilon-q)/beta.
escape_conditions: beta=0 in exponent accounting, as for L_N=(log N)^d with fixed d.
A genuinely nonblackbox use of SAT circuits not summarized by per-query substitution.
A stronger source lower bound with exponent exceeding q+beta c for each targeted c.
A direct nonuniform lower bound for H_N independent of black-box substitution.
negative_tactic_decision.exact_negation_or_method_class: Black-box target-circuit substitution interfaces with source size N, M_N=N^q queries, target query length N^beta or exp((log N)^o(1)), and overhead N^rho.
negative_tactic_decision.next_validation_handoff: Send cycle61.L1 and cycle61.L2 to pvsnp-symbolic-complexity-auditor for cost accounting, then to contradiction-route-auditor for the beta>0 no-go boundary and to timeline-definition-assumption-elicitor for label-free assumptions.
negative_tactic_decision.paper_contribution_potential: Potential paper-level scoped theorem: a polylog-query XOR magnification bridge plus a label-free codebook-sketch falsifier and an explicit extraction-gap no-go. It is not a proof of P != NP.
proof_obligations: Compute q,rho,beta for every proposed carrier including generator, decoding, and padding overhead.
Derive the exact upper-bound exponent max{rho,q+beta c} or max{rho,q}+o(1) in the polylog case.
Record whether the transcript, generator, and proof object are label-free, nonrelativizing, non-natural, and advice-accounted.
For the XOR route, prove or refute extraction from arbitrary H_N circuits to constructively label-free codebook sketches.
negative_tactic_decision.reason_for_tactic: The decisive contradiction for polynomial-query interfaces is still the exponent cap q+beta c; the present cycle records that the XOR route escapes only by fixing beta=0 in exponent accounting via polylogarithmic queries.

branch_outputs.next_experiment: Instantiate a candidate generator and compute U_N,A_N,r_N,E_N for its SAT-preserving quotient codebook; if the cost is subthreshold, quarantine that generator, otherwise formulate the exact extraction theorem it would require.

result_atlas_open_obligations: Analyze a Merkleized global-constraint selector for random robust low-D carriers: compute its rooted edit exponent beta, check whether beta+D crosses epsilon, and test whether its verification transcript leaks interval access or only supplies a non-natural large-jump certificate.

Audit Karchmer-Wigderson and formula-depth transfers separately: determine whether a lifted SAT communication lower bound can validly certify formula-size or depth lower bounds while still failing for unrestricted SIZE(poly).

Audit approximate-junta transfers for low-influence or depth-2 targets: compute when Friedgut's J=exp(O(I/epsilon)) is below m for SIZE(m^k) subclasses, and separate genuine AC0/DNF progress from another unrestricted SIZE collapse.

Audit branching-program length-width lower bounds for SAT using the same exponent discipline: source object L*log W or time-space simulation, target class DTIME(m^k), and padding erosion under full input length.

Audit essential-variable and junta-dimension lower-bound routes: prove the compiler bound for SIZE(m^k), compute the universal ceiling m, and test padded SAT as the falsifier before considering any P-vs-NP transfer.
